description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), causes [DEF, RES and MND -50%] for 25 seconds, grants [Attach Earth], [Awoken Heavy Physical] and [Damage Cap +20000] to the user

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Heavy Physical
description.text: Heavy abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, grants [Heavy Charge +1] after using a Heavy ability
